definitions.explanation: Winning a championship in consecutive years or events. A major achievement in sports and competitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{3年|さんねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{連覇|れんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: That team achieved three consecutive championships.

examples.japanese: {連覇|れんぱ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途切|とぎ}れた→途切れる：18055_togireru⟧。
examples.english: The streak of consecutive championships was broken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{選手権|せんしゅけん}→選手権：14432_senshuken⟧{2連覇|にれんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: He's aiming for two consecutive world championship wins.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{連|れん} (consecutive, chain) + {覇|は} (supremacy, championship)

FORMS:
- {連覇|れんぱ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win consecutive championships)
- {連覇|れんぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧ (to achieve consecutive championships)

NUMBERED FORMS:
- {2連覇|にれんぱ} (two consecutive championships)
- {3連覇|さんれんぱ} (three consecutive championships)
- V2（ブイツー） (2nd consecutive win - alternate casual form)
- V3（ブイスリー） (3rd consecutive win)

- ⟦{連勝|れんしょう}→連勝：06528_renshou⟧ (consecutive wins - games)
